description: PHOENIX – Today, Arizona Gov. Katie Hobbs announced that her campaign committee, Elect Katie Hobbs, has raised nearly $6 million since she was elected governor in 2022. The contributions come from tens of thousands of supporters, and 96 percent of contributions are less than $100. Nearly half are new supporters who had not previously given […]
paid_for_by: Paid for by Elect Katie Hobbs
title: Elect Katie Hobbs Campaign Announces Nearly $6 Million Raised - Katie Hobbs for Governor
